topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I trusted you, believed in the stories you spun, the grand tales of your daily conquests. Now the truth unravels, threads of deceit exposed in stark daylight. Each word you uttered, a mask now shattered, revealing the hollow core beneath. I won't stand here, mouth agape, while you weave more lies to patch the gaps. The time for silence is over; the time for truth begins now. You owe me more than this facade, more than these empty promises. It's time to face the consequences, to stand tall and admit the fraud. I deserve better, and so do those who cared enough to listen.
